extracted.name: Square Pizza
instruction_lines: Add all no. 1 ingredients for the dough until form. Rest the dough for 30 minutes or until double the size

After the dough has rise, knitted and make it flat use a rolling pin. Then add all the topping ingredients start with the olive oil, bolognaise sauce, salami, cheese, sausage, bolognaise sauce and cheese again. Bake in oven 350f for 30 to 35 minutes.
